entries.method: System 1 (20-day breakout with skip filter and 55-day failsafe, 10-day exit)

sources.edition: The Original Turtle Trading Rules, 2003 participant publication (printed pp. 7-33)
Curtis M. Faith, Way of the Turtle (2007), unofficial 2012 Indonesian translation
sources.role: secondary; translation conflicts (60 vs 55 days) resolved in favour of W-TUR (#709)

knownLimitations: equity adaptation, long only: net long beta, not the futures risk profile
correlation limits (6 / 10 units): engine mechanics implemented, not applied in research runs: no point-in-time groups (TUR-SF-LIMIT-CORR, DATA_BLOCKED binding)
liquidity: no participation limit in the source ("liquid markets" = research universe protocol); every run reports fill participation of bar volume and of the 20-session mean as a diagnostic
cash account: with 1 % / N units only a few units fit in cash; REJECT_NO_CASH is counted

daily bars: the order of intrabar events is a convention: on a held bar exits come before adds and a raised stop is re-checked pessimistically; on the entry bar the order is entry -> adds -> unit stops above the channel level -> channel exit, even if the low was traded at the open (pessimistic, counted)
model assumptions are reported, never decided by result: MA-TUR-INTRABAR-ORDER (scenario ENTRY_BAR_OPTIMISTIC), MA-TUR-HELD-BAR-ORDER (fixed convention, no bound)

failsafe exit not stated in the source (TUR-SF-FAILSAFE-EXIT, SOURCE_AMBIGUOUS, scenario FAILSAFE_EXIT_20D); open hypothetical breakout not covered by the source (TUR-SF-S1-OPEN-BREAKOUT, SOURCE_AMBIGUOUS, scenario S1_OPEN_BREAKOUT_TAKEN)

market trend and relevant industry representatives

is the volume confirmation clear (alternatives A / B / C reported)?

strong overhead resistance nearby?
industry group stage (no data in the machine)
which correction low is significant for the initial stop?
